title: Can AI Survive 1,000 Conversations?
description:
Geoffrey Hinton recently suggested that some AI systems may already be conscious.

Maybe they are, maybe they're not.

But I think we're asking the wrong question.

AI can answer incredibly complex questions. The harder test is whether it can maintain understanding across 1,000 interconnected conversations without drifting, contradicting itself, or losing the thread.

Maybe intelligence isn't just about producing brilliant answers.

Maybe it's about sustaining understanding over time.

#AI #ArtificialIntelligence #GeoffreyHinton #AGI #Consciousness #MachineLearning
